parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order for the specified sort field. Valid values:

- `ASC` (default): Ascending order.

- `DESC`: Descending order.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from 1. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. The default value is 20.

parameters.name: RoleIds
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of role IDs.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The role type.

- `custom`: A custom role.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The sort field for paginated queries. Valid values:

- `GmtCreateTime` (default): Sorts by creation time.

- `GmtModifiedTime`: Sorts by modification time.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status. Valid values:

- `Creating`

- `Updating`

- `Deleting`

- `Succeeded`: A terminal state.

- `Failed`: A terminal state.

parameters.name: VerboseFields
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of fields to return. Currently, only `ModulePermissions` is supported, which returns the permission configuration of the role.

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace ID. Call the [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~) operation to get it.
